title: Reverse a String
description: Write a Java method that takes a string as input and returns the string reversed. You should not use any built-in reverse methods.

title: Check for Palindrome
description: Write a Java method that checks if a given string is a palindrome. A palindrome is a word that reads the same forwards and backward. The check should be case-insensitive.

title: Find the Maximum Element in an Array
description: Write a Java method that finds the largest integer in an array of integers. Return 0 if the array is empty.
